desc: Prove the reduction from arbitrary walkway/stair routes to a bottleneck connectivity level between the two queried blocks.
Derive the exact answer formula using source floor, destination floor, and the maximum mutually connected floor level.
Construct the maximum spanning tree efficiently from all horizontal and vertical adjacency edges.
Implement iterative LCA binary lifting on the tree, storing minimum edge weights along ancestor jumps.
Implement query handling, including same-block connectivity level equal to that block's height.
Run and verify the provided sample tests.
